comments.author: sugartitstm
comments.body_html:
Hey i know nobody probably cares about this, and you’ve stated in a prior comment that you can change the description yourself. However if you didn’t know while such things like .308 and 7.62x51 are similar they’re not the same, same with .223 and 5.56x45

You can safely shoot .223 out of a 5.56 barrel just fine, just like you can shoot 7.62x51 through a .308 barrel just fine, but shooting a 5.56 out of a .223 barrel or a .308 through a 7.62 barrel can be dangerous, this shit isn’t in Tarkov but hey its a little fun fact.

(Plus we have a separate .308 in the game that can be added with content backports, however this isn’t an issue for people that don’t want to/ haven’t added that backport)
